studies.Title: Large prospective investigation of meat intake, related mutagens, and risk of renal cell carcinoma.
studies.Reference: Large prospective investigation of meat intake, related mutagens, and risk of renal cell carcinoma.
studies.Journal: The American journal of clinical nutrition

extraction_supporting_text.sample_size: Design: Study participants (492,186) completed a detailed dietary assessment linked to a database of heme iron, heterocyclic amines (HCA), polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs), nitrate, and nitrite concentrations in cooked and processed meats. Over 9 (mean) y of follow-up, we identified 1814 cases of RCC (498 clear cell and 115 papillary adenocarcinomas).
